title: Pistachio German Dumplings with Earthy Filling
description: A hearty, comforting German-inspired dish with a delicious pistachio crust and an earthy mushroom filling. The perfect meal for a cozy evening.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and pistachio meal.
Gradually add warm water, mixing until dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place 1 tablespoon of mushroom filling in the center of each circle.
Fold dough over filling to form a half-moon shape, pressing edges to seal.
Place dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve hot with your favorite sauce or topping.
